title: Aider Review — The Best AI Pair-Programmer in Your Terminal? (2025)
summary: One-minute Aider review: terminal pair programmer with git-tracked diffs.

assertions.quote: It shows every diff before applying changes, keeps your project local

verdicts.note: Aider auto-commits and shows diffs, which aids control and rollback; whether that beats GUI editors' diff review is preference.

assertions.quote: You still need technical experience to review patches

verdicts.note: Studies show novices accept incorrect AI code more often; verifying output requires domain and code literacy.
The review concludes that skill in verification, constraint specification and review may matter as much as authoring skill, and that the central risk is a verification gap.
